newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Plutonic lifts March qtr gold production.
newsitem.headline: Plutonic lifts March qtr gold production.

text.p: Western Australian gold miner Plutonic Resources Ltd said on Tuesday it lifted March quarter production to 121,922 ounces, up 45 percent on the previous corresponding quarter.
Plutonic said its main Plutonic gold mine performed well with production of 61,093 ounces, the second highest quarterly production in six years.
Elsewhere, its Mt Morgans mine produced 20,074 ounces, Darlot 13,355 ounces, Lawlers 9,732 ounces, Peak Hill 9,358 ounces and Bellevue 8,310 ounces.
Plutonic said full details of March quarter production would be released later in April.
In calendar 1996, Plutonic's production of gold rose about 29 percent to 449,811 ounces from 1995.
Plutonic, about 30 percent owned by Malaysia Mining Corp Bhd, reported a steady net profit of A$40.70 million in 1996.
